title: The Impact of Coupons on the Visit-to-Purchase Funnel
eligible_reason: Randomized mobile-coupon field experiment (five arms: base/better coupon x low/high-value segment, two control groups); cross-sectional comparisons of visit, purchase, redemption and amount across arms. No staggered adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: code.sas imports simuldata.xlsx (one row per individual) and tabulates means of Visit, Purchase, Redeem, Amount, Pageviews, Discount by Group (T1L, T1H, T2H, CGL, CGH) for Tables 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b. No panel, no fixed effects.
data_files_note: readme.txt: 'a simulated data set (simuldata.xlsx), containing variables akin to the ones reported in our paper'; sas_output.xlsx shows tables from the simulated data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
